title: thelypteris tristis
intro: Thelypteris tristis, commonly known as the poor man's fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the fern class Pteridophyta. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including the health benefits of treating fever, rheumatism, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris tristis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
